Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.
Structural fit audit. Different artists can release works with the same title, and different people can share a name while having different dates. Identify each allowed referent before comparing claims. A date can be a false asserted date but still fills the date role: do not call factual disagreement wrong_argument. Reserve wrong_argument for an actual role/type mismatch. Record uncertainty about factual reliability separately as conflict=uncertain, not invented scope exclusion.
